description: The plot illustrates the relative change in an unspecified metric across different layers, comparing various configurations of token count and bit precision. The x-axis represents the layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32) on a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale, ranging from -25% to 5% in increments of 5%. The plot displays five lines: a grey dashed line representing the "Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit" at 0% relative change; a yellow line with diamond markers for "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit", remaining relatively stable around 0% across all layer ranges; a red line with square markers for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit", starting at approximately -1% for Layer1-4, decreasing to around -3.5% for Layer13-20, and then increasing to about -2% for Layer29-32; a light blue line with circle markers for "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit", beginning at around -2% for Layer1-4, decreasing to approximately -8% for Layer13-20, and then rising to about -5% for Layer29-32; and a dark blue line with square markers for "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit", starting at roughly -3% for Layer1-4, dropping to around -23% for Layer13-20, and then increasing to about -6% for Layer29-32.
